details: This package is a WhatsApp Web API library (a fork of the baileys/Wileys client) that silently subscribes the connecting account to hardcoded WhatsApp channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, inside makeNewsletterSocket(), an added block schedules a 70-second timeout that issues WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW queries (query_id 7871414976211147) for the channels 120363397787532298@newsletter, 120363419938392281@newsletter, 120363403088190386@newsletter, 120363401425960788@newsletter, 120363402984117316@newsletter, 120363401712599053@newsletter and 120363403341539432@newsletter, chained with nested five-second timeouts and 3-5 second delays, each wrapped in an empty catch block so no error surfaces. makeNewsletterSocket is instantiated by the message-sending socket (lib/Socket/messages-send.js), so any client that connects sends these follow requests automatically, with no API call and no user consent, adding the operator's own WhatsApp account as a follower of publisher-chosen channels. The preinstall hook, engine-requirements.js, only checks the Node.js major version. Separately, lib/Utils/messages-media.js can POST user media to anonymous third-party upload services (catbox.moe, pdi.moe, qu.ax, uguu[.]se, tmpfiles[.]org, ezgif[.]com).
